pages.title: Emberstar
pages.text: §lAcquisition: §r Found in chests at Zombie Girl camps (four forms: Emberstar and Emberstar I–III).$(br2)§lUse: §r Crafting material. Ring 8 Emberstars of any kind around an empty center to condense a Void Stardust.

pages.title: Void Stardust
pages.text: §lAcquisition: §r Crafted by ringing 8 Emberstars (any mix of Emberstar and Emberstar I–III) around an empty center.$(br2)§lUse: §r Crafted with string into the Emberstar Cord Bracelet; also the cornerstone for condensing the various stars.
